name.description: Parent-facing name of the reusable template, not a finished task or passage title.

instanceParameters.description: Additional task-specific choices only. Do not duplicate topic, audience, difficulty or question count, including equivalent fields under other names.

required.description: True rejects omission when no default exists and rejects blank text. Defaults apply to omitted values regardless of this flag.

default.description: Default matching the field type, bounds and options; null means no default. Preserve supplied source text.

min.description: Inclusive integer lower bound; null when unbounded or not an integer field.

max.description: Inclusive integer upper bound; null when unbounded or not an integer field.

maxLength.description: Text length limit; null uses 500 for text fields. Use null for other types.

options.description: Distinct, trimmed, single-line select values; null for other field types.

instructions.description: Directions to create a learner task, not another template. Order: goal and activity; content and source requirements; additional parameter effects; task-specific question requirements. Omit inapplicable parts and engine rules. Keep shared setting values in defaults.

defaults.description: Shared settings that the parent can change for each task.

topic.description: Default subject or theme, in the requested language.

audience.description: Intended learners: age, grade or experience, in the requested language.

difficulty.description: Challenge relative to the audience: guided recall, application, or deeper reasoning.

questionCount.description: Default number of questions, adjustable for each task.
